hec.rss.model

Class ResSystemOpSet

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.Observable
      • hec.lang.NamedType
        • hec.rss.model.ResSystemOpSet
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, AltInputReportInfc, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.lang.Comparable, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable

    public class ResSystemOpSet
extends NamedType
implements AsciiSerializable, java.io.Serializable, AltInputReportInfc
    The object represents the Operational model for a System of Reservoirs. The set of reservoirs acts as one giant reservoir. ResSystemOpSet allows the setting of operational rules and storage zones as a whole, which are defined by each individual reservoir
    Version:
    1.0;
    Author:
    Shannon Newbold, RMA 06/2000
